expectedMetricRanges.notes: Terminal build diversity must cover at least four distinct weapon bases.
No single terminal weapon base may dominate more than 40% of full-route terminal builds.
Profession-aligned weapon adoption must remain at or above 75%.
Profession capstone visibility remains mandatory and each foundation profession must see at least one capstone.
Profession capstone adoption must stay materially visible in terminal builds.
Non-weapon build payoff must remain materially adopted in full-route runs.
All four foundation professions must adopt at least one profession capstone.
All four foundation professions must adopt at least one non-weapon build payoff.

notes: PR-03 cutover baseline for build identity reward adoption. Per-profession floors are blocking, not report-only.
